format: First-round groups with playoffs where points were tied, followed by quarter-finals, semi-finals, a third-place match and a final.
substitution_policy: No in-match substitutions were permitted in the 1958 FIFA World Cup, so every match has an empty substitutions array.

notes: Jozef Buberník was sent off in the 102nd minute.
The RSSSF archive prints the fifth French goal as 5:2 at minute 66; the score progression establishes it as 5:3.
Scotland missed a penalty in the 23rd minute; the RSSSF archive attributes the miss to Howie.
The match was preceded by the World Cup opening ceremony.
Sweden missed a penalty in the 69th minute; the RSSSF archive credits the miss to Nils Liedholm.
József Sipos was sent off in the 79th minute.
Some sources award the second Soviet goal to Valentin Ivanov.
Austria missed a penalty in the 55th minute; Lev Yashin saved Erich Buzek's attempt.
Hans Juskowiak was sent off in the 89th minute.
